## Safety and provenance checklist

- [ ] Every commit includes a DCO `Signed-off-by:` trailer.
- [ ] Tests and examples use only invented synthetic data.
- [ ] No secrets, real client data, private course material, or local source paths are included.
- [ ] Public v1 imports and all nine CLI commands remain compatible.
- [ ] The change adds no live posting, approval, sending, payment, filing, deletion, settings, bank-detail, hosted-model, or production-infrastructure authority.
- [ ] Documentation and release evidence are updated when directly affected.
- [ ] I disclosed checks that could not run and any remaining risk.

Merging this pull request does not authorize publication, deployment, or
production use.
